विश्वास-प्रस्तुतिः (यन्त्र-स्वरः)

सर्वाष् टीकाः
Gemini 3.8 Flash

“Through Agni and Soma the sacrifice possesses sight,” [he says].
Agni and Soma are indeed the two eyes of the sacrifice.
By the eye of the sacrifice itself he places sight in himself.

सर्वाष् टीकाः
Gemini 3.8 Flash

“Sacrificed is the sacrifice by the Bhṛgus, giving wealth through the Yatis,” [he says].
This is indeed the milking of the sacrifice.
He milks the sacrifice itself.
“May the wealth of that sacrificed, well-sacrificed sacrifice come to me,” [he says].
He prays for a blessing.
“The Aṅgirases have sacrificed for me in this sacrifice with morning-recitations,” [he says].
This is indeed the milking of blessings.
“A Vasu is the sacrifice, possessing Vasus is the sacrifice,” [he says].
He makes the sacrifice possess Vasus.

मूलम्

इष्टो यज्ञो भृगुभिर्द्रविणोदा यतिभिरिति यज्ञस्य वा एष दोहो यज्ञमेवैतद्दुहे तस्य यज्ञस्येष्टस्य स्विष्टस्य द्रविणमागच्छत्त्वित्याशिषमेवाशास्ते ऽङ्गिरसो मे ऽस्य यज्ञस्य प्रातरनुवाकैरहौषुरित्याशिषामेवैष दोहो वसुर्यज्ञो वसुमान्यज्ञ इति वसुमन्तमेव यज्ञं कुरुते

“Thou art full; may there be fullness for me!”, [he says].
From whatever desires he is deficient, those he fills up.
Agni indeed burns the sacrificer who is excessive.
He causes [water] to flow continuously.
Following the waters being released, the sacrificer is released.
Moreover, by means of the waters he thus shields himself from Agni,
so as not to be burned.
Truly the sacrifice of this one, wiping itself, settles down upon everything with sorrow—what is his homes, what is his cattle.
“May the divine officiating priests wipe [themselves] with the eastern quarter!”, [he says].
These are indeed the wipings of the sacrifice, these are its pacifications.
Wiped is his sacrifice;
